int_name: S 6TH ST & S INDEPENDENCE MALL W

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and signalization. However, the effective sidewalk width is reduced by outdoor dining furniture, and the pavement surface shows visible signs of wear and cracking.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Outdoor dining furniture and planters significantly narrow the effective width of the sidewalk for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the building facade

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracks and uneven surfaces in the roadway and crosswalk area could pose a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground of the roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corner to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair cracks and uneven surfaces in the crosswalk and intersection area to ensure a smooth walking surface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone Management
interventions.description: Enforce clear path requirements for outdoor dining to ensure adequate space for all pedestrians, including those with mobility aids.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with well-maintained sidewalks, high-visibility crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. The environment is bordered by a park and large institutional buildings, providing a generally pleasant but standard pedestrian experience without advanced physical protection like refuge islands.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian refuge
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire roadway in one stage without a protected waiting area.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

hazards.name: Potential for high vehicle speeds
hazards.description: The straight, open nature of the road may encourage higher speeds than appropriate for a park-adjacent area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Provide a safe space for pedestrians to wait mid-crossing, especially useful for slower walkers.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Physically slow down traffic at the point of crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide sidewalks. The environment is characterized by institutional architecture and a park, with clear traffic control measures and good pavement quality.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a mid-point refuge island.

hazards.name: Traffic Merge Point
hazards.description: A 'Lane Ends Merge Left' sign indicates a merge area near the crosswalk, which can lead to driver distraction and unpredictable vehicle movements near pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The environment features a marked crosswalk at a signalized intersection with sidewalks on both sides. Mature trees provide a pleasant buffer on one side, but parked vehicles on the opposite side may create sightline issues for pedestrians entering the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right curb line can block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The crossing distance is wide enough that a median or refuge island would improve safety for slower pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel lines with continental or ladder markings to increase visibility to drivers.
